title.zh: Ripple与Robinhood扩大合作，将RLUSD引入零售与机构市场
title.en: 【Ripple 与 Robinhood 达成战略合作】

current_state.zh: Ripple与Robinhood扩大合作，将RLUSD带给零售和机构用户，Robinhood计划进行XRP Ledger结算并采用Ripple Treasury，同时扩大BNY托管和C2FO贸易融资整合。
current_state.en: Ripple and Robinhood expanded their partnership to bring RLUSD to retail and institutional users, with Robinhood planning XRP Ledger settlement and adopting Ripple Treasury, alongside expanded BNY custody and C2FO trade-finance integrations.

updates.title_zh: 【Ripple 与 Robinhood 达成战略合作】
updates.title_en: 【Ripple 与 Robinhood 达成战略合作】
updates.what_changed_zh: Ripple与Robinhood宣布战略合作，RLUSD将接入Robinhood Chain、Bitstamp by Robinhood，并随后接入Robinhood App用于机构结算；同时Robinhood采用Ripple Treasury实现全球资金管理自动化，并通过Ripple Prime扩展借贷、保证金融资和现货交易。
updates.what_changed_en: Ripple and Robinhood announced a strategic partnership under which RLUSD will be integrated across Robinhood Chain, Bitstamp by Robinhood and later the Robinhood App for institutional settlement, while Robinhood adopts Ripple Treasury for global treasury automation and expands lending, margin financing and spot trading through Ripple Prime.
updates.current_state_zh: Ripple与Robinhood宣布战略合作，RLUSD将接入Robinhood Chain、Bitstamp by Robinhood，并随后接入Robinhood App用于机构结算；同时Robinhood采用Ripple Treasury实现全球资金管理自动化，并通过Ripple Prime扩展借贷、保证金融资和现货交易。
updates.current_state_en: Ripple and Robinhood announced a strategic partnership under which RLUSD will be integrated across Robinhood Chain, Bitstamp by Robinhood and later the Robinhood App for institutional settlement, while Robinhood adopts Ripple Treasury for global treasury automation and expands lending, margin financing and spot trading through Ripple Prime.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Ripple and Robinhood announced a strategic partnership under which RLUSD will be integrated across Robinhood Chain, Bitstamp by Robinhood and later the Robinhood App for institutional settlement, while Robinhood adopts Ripple Treasury for global treasury automation and expands lending, margin financing and spot trading through Ripple Prime.

updates.title_zh: Robinhood采用Ripple的稳定币、资金管理软件和交易贷款
updates.title_en: Robinhood Taps Ripple's Stablecoin, Treasury Software and Trading Loans
updates.what_changed_zh: RLUSD 已在 Robinhood Chain 和 Bitstamp 上线，并预计今年晚些时候接入 Robinhood 主应用；Ripple Prime 已在 Bitstamp 为约 20 种数字资产提供借贷和保证金融资，并计划今年晚些时候在 Bitstamp 增加永续合约交易。
updates.what_changed_en: RLUSD went live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, with the main Robinhood app expected later this year; Ripple Prime already provides lending and margin financing across roughly 20 digital assets at Bitstamp and plans to add perpetual futures there later this year.
updates.current_state_zh: Ripple 与 Robinhood 的战略合作已进入执行阶段：RLUSD 已在 Robinhood Chain 和 Bitstamp 上线，预计今年晚些时候接入 Robinhood 主应用；Robinhood 采用 Ripple Treasury 管理全球资金，Bitstamp 机构业务将使用 XRP Ledger 上的 RLUSD 进行机构结算；Ripple Prime 已在 Bitstamp 提供约 20 种资产的借贷和保证金融资，并计划今年晚些时候增加永续合约交易。
updates.current_state_en: The Ripple-Robinhood strategic partnership has moved into execution: RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp and is expected to reach the main Robinhood app later this year; Robinhood is adopting Ripple Treasury for global treasury operations, Bitstamp's institutional business will use RLUSD on the XRP Ledger for institutional settlement, and Ripple Prime already provides lending and margin financing across roughly 20 assets at Bitstamp with perpetual futures planned later this year.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Robinhood is integrating Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, adopting Ripple Treasury for global cash management, and using RLUSD on the XRP Ledger for institutional settlement, with Ripple Prime already lending across roughly 20 assets at Bitstamp and perpetual futures planned later this year.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Robinhood is integrating Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, adopting Ripple Treasury for global cash management, and using RLUSD on the XRP Ledger for institutional settlement, with Ripple Prime already lending across roughly 20 assets at Bitstamp and perpetual futures planned later this year.
